STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_168778.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_168778.v · Open raw
module origen_168778(
    input clk,
    input key0,
    input key1,
    output reg [12:0] seg,
    output reg [5:0] minu,
    output reg [4:0] h
);

reg [1:0] key1_state, key0_state;
reg [15:0] counter;
reg [5:0] estado;

parameter UPDATE_SEC = 6'd0,
          UPDATE_MINU = 6'd1,
          UPDATE_H = 6'd2,
          ZERAR_H = 6'd3,
          PAUSE = 6'd4,
          RESET = 6'd5;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    key1_state <= {key1_state[0], key1};
    key0_state <= {key0_state[0], key0};
    counter <= counter + 16'd1;
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
    case (estado)
        RESET: begin
            seg <= 13'b0000000000000;
            minu <= 6'b000000;
            h <= 5'b00000;
            if (key0_state == 2'b01) begin
                estado <= UPDATE_SEC;
            end
        end
        UPDATE_SEC: begin
            if (counter == 50000) begin
                counter <= 16'b0;
                seg[6:0] <= seg[6:0] + 7'b0000001;
                if (seg[6:0] == 7'b1100010) begin
                    seg[6:0] <= 7'b0000000;
                    estado <= UPDATE_MINU;
                end
            end
            if (key1_state == 2'b01) begin
                estado <= PAUSE;
            end
            if (key0_state == 2'b01) begin
                estado <= RESET;
            end
        end
        UPDATE_MINU: begin
            seg[6:0] <= 7'b0000000;
            minu <= minu + 6'b000001;
            if (minu == 6'b111100) begin
                minu <= 6'b000000;
                estado <= UPDATE_H;
            end
            if (key1_state == 2'b01) begin
                estado <= PAUSE;
            end
            if (key0_state == 2'b01) begin
                estado <= RESET;
            end
        end
        UPDATE_H: begin
            minu <= 6'b000000;
            h <= h + 5'b00001;
            if (h == 5'b11000) begin
                h <= 5'b00000;
                estado <= ZERAR_H;
            end
            if (key1_state == 2'b01) begin
                estado <= PAUSE;
            end
            if (key0_state == 2'b01) begin
                estado <= RESET;
            end
        end
        ZERAR_H: begin
            h <= 5'b00000;
            estado <= UPDATE_SEC;
        end
        PAUSE: begin
            if (key1_state == 2'b01) begin
                estado <= UPDATE_SEC;
            end
            if (key0_state == 2'b01) begin
                estado <= RESET;
            end
        end
    endcase
end

endmodule
